<title level="1" right="Spell 4" pfs="Standard">
[Unfettered Movement](/Spells.aspx?ID=1732)
<actions string="Two Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Concentrate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=32" />
<trait label="Manipulate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=104" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 365

**Traditions**
[Arcane](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=1), [Divine](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=2), [Primal](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=4)

<row gap="medium">

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** touch

**Target** 1 creature touched
</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** 10 minutes
</row>

</column>

---

You repel hindrances that would affect a creature. While under this spell's effect, the target ignores effects that would give them a circumstance penalty to Speed. When they attempt to Escape an effect that has them [immobilized](/Conditions.aspx?ID=24), [grabbed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=20), or [restrained](/Conditions.aspx?ID=33), they automatically succeed unless the effect is [magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103) and of a higher rank than the _unfettered movement_ spell.
name: Unfettered Movement
